items.stem: Choose the correct measure word: "一 ___ 书" (one ___ book).

options.rationale: Correct: 本 (ben) is the standard measure word for books.
只 (zhi) is used for certain animals, not books.
张 (zhang) is for flat objects like paper, not bound books.
杯 (bei) is for cups of liquid, not books.

items.stem: A gap-fill reading item is best answered by:

options.text: Choosing the word whose meaning fits the whole sentence
options.rationale: Correct: the correct word is the one that makes the sentence meaningful and grammatical.

options.text: Choosing any character of the right shape
options.rationale: Shape does not determine meaning or fit.
Length is irrelevant to the correct choice.
A choice must be made to score.

items.stem: Which TWO strategies help on an HSK 3 listening true/false item?

options.text: Listening for the overall meaning, not just single words
options.rationale: Correct: meaning, not isolated words, decides the match.

options.text: Reading the statement before the audio plays
options.rationale: Correct: knowing the statement focuses listening.

options.text: Assuming the statement is true if any word matches
options.rationale: A single matching word does not make a statement true.
The statement must be understood to judge it.

options.text: Choosing true whenever the audio is long
options.rationale: Audio length is irrelevant to truth value.

items.explanation: Correct: meaning, not isolated words, decides the match.
